message.content: The sea can appear in many colors depending on depth, weather, and the presence of algae or sediment. In clear, shallow waters it often looks turquoise or aquamarine, while deeper ocean water tends toward a deep blue or indigo hue. On cloudy days or when the water is murky, it may look gray or greenish. So, the sea’s color is variable rather than fixed!
